summary: Ledgerly sells accounts payable software to mid-size Indian manufacturers and is raising a $2M Seed on a SAFE. The monthly sheet shows ₹48 L revenue in September 2026 (about ₹5.76 Cr a year), growing about 7% a month, with 92 paying customers. The deck's ₹7.5 Cr ARR is 30% above what the sheet supports, so ask how it was calculated before the first call.

traction.reason: The sheet confirms ₹48 L revenue in September 2026 and about 7% monthly growth over six months with 92 paying customers, which is strong for a Seed company. The deck's ₹7.5 Cr ARR is higher than the sheet supports, so this judgement uses the sheet.
evidence: Average growth 7% a month, Apr to Sep 2026 (sheet)

team.reason: The CEO spent seven years as finance controller at an auto components maker, the buyer this product serves, and the CTO spent six years as a senior engineer building an invoicing platform. They have worked together since 2022 and shipped a product with 92 paying customers.
evidence: Ananya Rao: Finance Controller, Kestrel Auto Components, 2015 to 2022 (deck p.8, profile)
Vikram Joshi: Senior Software Engineer, Brightpath Software, 2016 to 2022 (deck p.8, profile)
Both directors since incorporation in June 2022 (registry)

founderChecks.detail: The profile shows Finance Controller at Kestrel Auto Components from April 2015 to May 2022.
The profile shows Senior Software Engineer at Brightpath Software from July 2016 to March 2022.

strengths: Revenue of ₹48 L in September 2026 with about 7% monthly growth, confirmed by the sheet
92 paying manufacturers and 118% net revenue retention (deck p.4); 78% gross margin (deck p.5)
The CEO ran finance at an auto components maker for seven years, the buyer this product serves (deck p.8, profile)
Fits the fund's rules: India, B2B software, Seed, $2M round
concerns: The deck's ₹7.5 Cr ARR is 30% higher than the ₹5.76 Cr a year the sheet supports
11 months of runway at ₹55 L monthly burn (deck p.9, sheet)
The $2.1B market size assumes $44,000 of yearly spend per manufacturer (deck p.6), above Ledgerly's own price of ₹25,000 to ₹1.5 lakh a month (deck p.5)
No earlier funding or SAFE valuation cap stated
founderQuestions: Your deck shows ARR of ₹7.5 Cr for September 2026, while the monthly sheet shows ₹48 L of revenue that month, about ₹5.76 Cr a year. Could you share how the ₹7.5 Cr was calculated, for example whether it includes signed contracts that aren't live yet?
What valuation cap and discount are you proposing for the SAFE?
Have you raised any money before this round?
Over what period and across how many customers is the 118% net revenue retention measured?
With 11 months of runway, how long will the $2M round last at your hiring plan?
